insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 54.55% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $543,277 to $9,954,851, a 18.32x increase.
